title: Chapter 14
content:
The moment Il-hyun pressed his thumb to the biometric sensor, the elevator glided downward.

When the metal doors slid open, the very first thing to greet Jakyeong’s eyes was, unexpectedly, an oil painting. Following Il-hyun down the corridor, Jakyeong noted that despite being a subterranean level, the ventilation was immaculate—completely devoid of that damp, stagnant odor typical of basements. It felt far less confining than anticipated; with exquisite artwork lining the walls at regular intervals, one could easily mistake the floor for a private gallery.

Through the reinforced glass panels flanking the hallway, several amenities came into view: a fully equipped fitness center, a private screening room, and an indoor firing range.

As they passed the shooting range, Il-hyun glanced over. "Have you ever fired a gun?"

"Never," Jakyeong lied smoothly.

"I'll teach you sometime if the opportunity arises."

Jakyeong offered a timid, polite decline. Not to boast, but he was dead certain he could outshoot Kang Il-hyun with both eyes closed.

No matter how thoroughly he scanned his surroundings, nothing looked like a place to stash high-value syndicate collateral. The area was so utterly mundane it was almost insulting—he’d fretted over breaching this floor for nothing. Continuing along the corridor, they finally came to a halt before the very last door.

It was the only entryway fitted with an electronic deadbolt.

Without the slightest hesitation, Il-hyun punched in an eight-digit passcode and laid his thumb over the scanner. Jakyeong committed the sequence to memory in a heartbeat.

The heavy, sound-dampened door unlocked with a quiet hiss. Stepping inside, the first thing that caught Jakyeong’s eye was a massive, centuries-old Buddhist statue. Beyond it stretched a vast sanctuary packed with antique scrolls, rare ceramics, and priceless relics.

"Wow... It feels like you relocated an entire museum down here."

"In a way, yes. A few pieces were actually acquired from museums."

Jakyeong shot him a dubious glance. Sensing the unspoken question, Il-hyun added with a faint smile that none were stolen—most had been presented to him as gifts. Who on earth gifts someone a centuries-old Buddha or ancient scrolls? Several artifacts rested beneath temperature-controlled glass cases: celadon porcelain, ornate censers, and royal crowns that looked like they belonged in history textbooks.

Il-hyun methodically walked him through the collection, explaining the provenance of each piece. His low, resonant baritone was smooth, enunciating each syllable with cleaner precision than a professional voice actor. Jakyeong found himself listening with genuine fascination before catching himself—Right. The safe. He forced his focus back to the mission.

Browsing further into the room, he drifted toward an open display cabinet on the opposite wall. Unlike the main hall, this shelving unit housed artifacts predominantly of Japanese and Chinese origin.

"Feel free to handle anything on those shelves," Il-hyun offered.

Curious, Jakyeong picked up a thick, remarkably well-preserved book. The moment he flipped the heavy cover open, his face twisted into a grimace.

A Japanese shunga—an antique erotic art album. Turning to the next page, he was greeted by an explicit, vivid illustration of lovers tangled in an intricate posture.

Leaving the artistic composition aside, the male anatomy was rendered with such exaggerated, monstrous proportions and raw detail that it made him instinctively recoil. The woodblock print showed a man violently driving his oversized member into a woman lying with her thighs spread wide.

Jakyeong quietly shut the album.

A low, amused chuckle drifted from behind him. "You can keep looking if you like."

"I'm... I'm fine, thank you..."

Browsing down the shelf, the neighboring volumes were all variations of the same explicit theme. Whoever had gifted these to Il-hyun had peculiar tastes, but Jakyeong had zero desire to inspect the rest. If only the client's target item were one of these erotic prints—he could have pocketed the book, put a bullet through Il-hyun’s skull, and walked out the front door.

Swallowing a disappointed sigh, he moved a few paces to the right, where delicate antique vessels were arranged in neat rows. Among the uniform porcelain, a vibrant, ornate bottle caught his attention. It was a classic gourd-shaped flagon, sporting a hue and silhouette that hit Jakyeong’s aesthetic tastes dead-on.

Remembering he had permission to touch, he lifted the vessel without asking. Giving it a gentle tilt, a soft, liquid slosh echoed from within. He glanced over his shoulder—Il-hyun was occupied, checking a message on his phone.

Driven by curiosity, Jakyeong gripped the stopper and twisted. It was stiff, requiring a firm crank, but the moment the seal broke, an intoxicating aroma billowed out.

Vintage liquor?

He brought the narrow opening to his nose and drew in a deep, testing inhale. The scent was surprisingly sugary and rich. It didn't smell like alcohol, but the fragrance was overwhelmingly potent—strangely appetizing, like a feast laid out before a starving man. The more he inhaled, the stronger the urge grew to drink in the scent.

As he involuntarily took another deep drag through his nose, Il-hyun’s voice cut through the air behind him.

"Yi-an."

In a split second, the world tilted violently. The strength vanished from Jakyeong's arms and legs in a catastrophic wave of vertigo.

Clatter!

The antique bottle slipped from his numb fingers, shattering against the floor as Jakyeong collapsed onto his knees.

Il-hyun crossed the room in an instant, his sharp features pulled into a troubled frown. "Are you alright? Did you... inhale that?"

The low voice buzzed in Jakyeong’s ears like static.

His heart hammered against his ribs like a war drum, blood surging through his veins at an unnatural, blistering speed. His vision blurred at the edges, his lips parting involuntarily as ragged, shallow pants tore from his chest.

Il-hyun stared down at him, his dark eyes taking in every tremor.

"What... haah... what is this? Is it... is it a drug?"

Il-hyun’s expression tightened with mild regret. "An aphrodisiac. An extraordinarily potent one. I should have warned you. Are you holding up?"

"You... you fucker... why tell me now...?"

With his rational filters completely dissolved, the profanity slipped out unfiltered. Jakyeong shook his head violently to clear the fog, but the motion only amplified the dizzying rush.

Worse, a furious, rock-hard erection was throbbing painfully against the front of his trousers. Mortified that it might show, he squeezed his thighs together and tried to scramble to his feet, but his limbs refused to cooperate.

As Jakyeong’s hands slipped uselessly against the polished floor, Il-hyun caught his arm, effortlessly draping it over his own broad shoulders.

"Stand up. Lean on me."

The moment their chests pressed together, the heat radiating from Il-hyun’s body sent a bolt of raw, primal lust tearing through Jakyeong’s veins—completely obliterating the fact that the person holding him was a man. Though hauled upright by Il-hyun's grip, Jakyeong’s body sagged like wet laundry, his feverish skin practically melting against the older man. Pure, unadulterated instinct urged him to wrap his arms around Il-hyun and grind against him.

Terrified of where that impulse would lead, Jakyeong shoved weakly at Il-hyun’s shoulder.

"Wait... get off me. If you touch me... fuck... ah!"

The moment the contact broke, Jakyeong’s legs gave out entirely, sliding down to the floor in a pathetic heap. His head rolled back, his vision spinning wildly as the ceiling and floor swapped places. Il-hyun stood over him, his towering silhouette fading in and out of the haze.

It felt like riding a relentless roller coaster after downing a bottle of hard liquor—nausea churning in his gut, head spinning out of control, his body completely disconnected from his will, while a bottomless well of lust bubbled up beneath his skin.

I have to snap out of it.

He raised a trembling hand to slap himself across the face, but Il-hyun caught his wrist mid-air. The grip was searing hot. With maddening slowness, Il-hyun’s thumb stroked the rapid pulse fluttering at the base of Jakyeong’s wrist.

A dirty, electrifying shiver ran up Jakyeong's spine.

Releasing the wrist, Il-hyun leaned down, locking eyes with him. "Is it unbearable?"

Jakyeong’s head dropped limp against his chest. His thoughts were a bleached-out void; forming coherent sentences was impossible. Hot breath washed over his ear, and Il-hyun’s voice resonated with terrifying, crystalline clarity.

"Want me to help you?"

The tender, almost affectionate tone turned Jakyeong’s muscles to liquid. Panting heavily, he slumped motionless. Even through the narcotic haze, he understood the offer perfectly.

Lifting his heavy eyelids, he took in Il-hyun’s face—absurdly handsome, sculpted with aristocratic perfection. The man looked like a masterpiece that belonged right alongside the statues in this vault.

"Shall I help?"

Beneath the gentle inquiry, Il-hyun’s gaze burned with the lethal hunger of a coiled viper. He's a man. Kang Il-hyun is a guy. Reason screamed at Jakyeong to shove the bastard away, but his body was screaming for someone—anyone—to take hold of him and wring out the torment.

Borrowing a hand won't kill me.

Lust drowned out the last remnants of logic.

Jakyeong gave an almost imperceptible nod.

Instantly, Il-hyun’s hands seized his waist, hauling him backward until Jakyeong was lying flat on his back, staring up at the vaulted ceiling.

Click. Zzzzip.

The sharp sound of his trouser zipper sliding down cut through the haze. Jakyeong assumed Il-hyun was going to use his hands, or perhaps his mouth. Unexpected. Is Kang Il-hyun gay? There was nothing in the dossier about that.

What if he uses this as an excuse to demand I fuck him later? I have no interest in topping a guy. Even in his delirium, stray thoughts flickered through his mind.

His trousers were stripped away. Il-hyun rose and stepped around, positioning himself above Jakyeong's head.

Moments later, a cool, viscous liquid was poured directly over Jakyeong’s erection. The lubricant coated his shaft, dripping down to soak his testicles and the perineum below, slicking the cleft of his buttocks.

Jakyeong stared blankly at the ceiling through half-lidded, glazed eyes. Suck it, stroke it, just do something already...

He tried to voice the demand, but his tongue was too heavy to move. Frustrated, he reached down to grip his own cock, but his numb fingers lacked the coordination to bring relief.

Il-hyun caught his roaming hand, firmly pinning it to the floor, before reaching down to seize both of Jakyeong’s ankles.

With effortless strength, Il-hyun hoisted Jakyeong’s legs up into the air, spreading his thighs wide.

Wait... why my legs?

Before Jakyeong could process the shift, his hips were hoisted off the floor, and something scorching, thick, and rock-hard pressed bluntly against his rear entrance.

The drug-induced fog shattered.

Jakyeong’s eyes blew wide in sheer horror as an unimaginable, tearing agony ripped through his lower half.

"W-Wait... aagh!"

The pain was monstrous—like a broadsword being driven straight up his spine.

Jakyeong thrashed like a freshly landed fish, his arms clawing desperately at the empty air. The reality of what Kang Il-hyun was doing crashed over him with the force of a tidal wave.

Every trace of the narcotic haze evaporated as if doused in freezing water. An entrance never meant to be breached was being forcibly torn open.

Digging deep into the absolute dregs of his adrenaline, Jakyeong wrenched his captured ankles free from Il-hyun’s grip, coiled his leg back, and drove a vicious heel strike straight into the side of Il-hyun’s jaw.

CRACK!

The impact snapped Il-hyun’s head violently to the side. The massive intrusion tearing at Jakyeong's core slipped out with a wet slide.

Gasping for breath, Jakyeong rolled over, scrambling backward to put distance between them.

Il-hyun brought a thumb to his bruised cheek, testing the inside of his mouth with his tongue. Slowly lowering his dark brows, a thoroughly wicked, unrepentant grin spread across his face.

"How cruel," Il-hyun drawled, his eyes gleaming with amusement. "And here I was, just trying to be helpful."

Translator's Notes (A/N):

  • Shunga (춘화집 / 春畫): Traditional East Asian (notably Japanese Edo-period) erotic woodblock prints and illustrated albums depicting explicit sexual encounters, often characterized by comically exaggerated genitalia.

  • Aphrodisiac / Heungbunje (흥분제): In classic martial arts and underworld fiction (Murim / Noir tropes), rare ancient aphrodisiac incenses or tinctures stored in antique vessels are notorious for causing extreme, rational-paralyzing physical arousal upon inhalation.
